title: 15 March 1965: Filming: Help!, Austria
content:
The second day of filming for Help! in Austria took place on the ski slopes in Obertauern, Austria.

The Beatles and their stand-in doubles – Cliff Diggins, Mick Dillon, Peter Cheevers and Joe Dunne – were filmed skiing and on ski lifts. Scenes on the latter were completed on the following day.

Page last updated: 15 May 2010

  • 2015: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Palms Casino Resort, Las Vegas
  • 1999: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: 4th & B, San Diego

  • 1979: Mixing: Getting Closer by Wings
  • 1975: Mixing: Listen To What The Man Said by Wings
  • 1973: Television: James Paul McCartney
  • 1973: Recording: Sunshine Life For Me (Sail Away Raymond), Have You Seen My Baby by Ringo Starr
  • 1972: Recording: Loup (1st Indian On The Moon) by Wings
  • 1971: Recording: 3 Legs by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1970: Filming: Sentimental Journey by Ringo Starr
  • 1968: UK single release: Lady Madonna
  • 1967: Recording: Within You Without You
  • 1966: The Beatles fail to win any Grammy Awards
  • 1965: Mixing: Ticket To Ride
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Colston Hall, Bristol
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Storyville Jazz Club, Liverpool

  • 1961: The Beatles live: Liverpool Jazz Society, Liverpool
